{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue 999999.99)
qa_count = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
if qa_count > 0:
    sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
    print(f"Dropped {qa_count} QA orders.")

# Do NOT filter by status — conversion rate is based on `converted` flag over the full dataset
# The `converted` column is 1 if checkout completed, regardless of refund
# So we compute conversion rate on all rows
conversion_rates = sales.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print(f"Conversion rates by segment (on full dataset):\n{conversion_rates}")
print(f"Highest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.4f}")"}
